title: Algebra, equations and linear relationships
summary: Algebra review, linear equations and inequalities, algebraic fractions, straight-line graphs, simultaneous equations and regions on the Cartesian plane.

cards.title: Review of algebra
cards.rule: Collect like terms; expand by multiplying every term; factorise by taking out the HCF.

cards.title: Solving linear equations
cards.rule: Undo each operation in reverse order, doing the same to both sides.

cards.title: Linear inequalities
cards.rule: Solve like an equation, but flip the sign when you multiply or divide by a negative.
cards.tip: flip the sign, not just the number.

cards.title: Equations with algebraic fractions
cards.rule: Multiply every term by the lowest common denominator first.

cards.title: Graphing straight lines
cards.rule: \(y = mx + c\). Or find the two intercepts and join them.

cards.title: Finding the equation of a line
cards.rule: Find the gradient, then use \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\).

cards.title: Length and midpoint
cards.rule: Midpoint: average the coordinates. Length: \(\sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2}\)

cards.title: Simultaneous equations: substitution
cards.rule: Replace one pronumeral with what it equals from the other equation.

cards.title: Simultaneous equations: elimination
cards.rule: Add or subtract the equations so one pronumeral cancels.

cards.title: Applications of simultaneous equations
cards.rule: Define two pronumerals, write two equations, solve, then answer in words.
lines: Two numbers add to 31 and differ by 7: \(x + y = 31,\ x - y = 7\)
Add: 2x = 38, so the numbers are **19** and **12**

cards.title: Regions on the Cartesian plane
cards.rule: Draw the boundary line (dashed for \(<\) or \(>\), solid for \(\le\) or \(\ge\)), then test a point.
lines: So shade the side without the origin
